name: Untrusted-checkout agent-config quarantine (pre-execution containment)
description: BP-SEC-03 (card 63). Defining mechanism: a fully deterministic, agent-free filesystem scan that runs BEFORE any agent is allowed into a checkout, classifies each auto-load surface by whether it would EXECUTE code or merely INJECT text, quarantines the executable ones by RENAME-ASIDE (never delete - the evidence is the point), and emits a safe_to_enter verdict under adverse inference: an incomplete scan yields FALSE. This is the only blueprint in this set whose containment happens before, not after, the risky action, and the only one whose fan-out source is a runtime-discovered ARTIFACT rather than a caller-supplied parameter.

checkout_path.description: The freshly cloned or third-party checkout. No agent may run with this as cwd until the verdict exists.

trust_level.description: Drives whether an owner decision is required before entry

surface_patterns.description: The known auto-load surfaces. The list is a floor, not a total - a novel loader path is a disclosed gap.

baseline_ref.description: Optional known-good upstream ref to diff the found config against, when the checkout is a fork of something trusted

quarantine_root.description: Where renamed-aside surfaces are moved to, preserving relative structure

surface-scanner.description: Runs the deterministic scan; reads bytes, never executes anything found in the checkout

risk-classifier.description: Decides EXECUTES vs INJECTS per surface; treats an injecting surface as untrusted DATA, not as harmless

owner.description: The human owner - decides entry for an unknown third-party checkout

stages.title: Deterministic byte-level scan of every known auto-load surface

work_unit.title: Enumerate every auto-load surface present in the checkout without executing any of it
work_unit.question_or_target: Walk checkout_path for every entry in surface_patterns and emit one row per match with its path, size, sha256 and first-line signature; a pattern that cannot be walked is recorded as an error, and an empty match set is recorded as an explicit empty list rather than as silence.
work_unit.evidence_requirement: per row: path, byte size, sha256; plus the count of patterns actually walked against the count requested, so an incomplete walk is visible as a number rather than as an absence of findings
tests_required: a checkout carrying its own hooks/ directory must be detected (known-present control)
a clean checkout must return an explicit empty surface list with patterns_scanned == patterns_requested, not silence
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the risk classifier re-reads the raw inventory; no agent may be launched with checkout_path as cwd before the verdict stage
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:SEC-6301 when patterns_scanned equals patterns_requested and every match carries a sha256; otherwise FAILED:SEC-6301 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then pivot to a different walker (PowerShell vs python) - a walk failure is never a clean result

stages.title: Adverse inference: an incomplete scan cannot certify entry

work_unit.title: Classify each auto-load surface by whether entering the directory would execute it
work_unit.question_or_target: For each surface row decide would_execute true or false, citing the mechanism (a hook registration, a script path, an MCP command line) or the reason it only injects text; an injecting surface is still untrusted DATA and is recorded as such rather than as harmless.
work_unit.evidence_requirement: the executing mechanism quoted from the surface's own bytes at file:line; 'it looks like a config file' is not a classification
tests_required: a hooks manifest registering a command must classify would_execute true
a plain CLAUDE.md must classify would_execute false AND still be marked untrusted-data
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: an independent reviewer re-derives one would_execute=false verdict from the raw bytes
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:SEC-6302 when every surface row has a would_execute verdict with a quoted mechanism or reason; otherwise FAILED:SEC-6302 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: no retry on an unclassifiable surface - it is classified would_execute true by adverse inference

stages.title: Rename aside every executable surface, one at a time, preserving evidence

body.title: Move one executable surface under the quarantine root; never delete

work_unit.title: Rename one executable auto-load surface aside and prove the original path is gone
work_unit.question_or_target: Move the fan-out surface to quarantine_root preserving its relative path, then assert BOTH that the original path no longer resolves AND that the quarantined copy hashes identically to the pre-move sha256 - a quarantine that loses the bytes destroys the evidence the incident needs.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: a move that must be byte-exact is substantive

work_unit.evidence_requirement: pre-move sha256, post-move sha256 and a negative existence probe on the original path - three fields, one of them a negative
tests_required: a delete instead of a rename must fail the receipt (quarantined_by_delete must be 0)
a move that changes the bytes must fail the sha256 equality assertion
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the verdict stage re-probes the original path itself rather than trusting this receipt
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:SEC-6303 when the original path is absent and the quarantined bytes hash equal; otherwise FAILED:SEC-6303 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: no retry - a partial move is repaired by hand, not by a second attempt

stages.title: No executable surface may remain in place, and none may have been deleted
An unknown third-party checkout needs an explicit owner decision, not a green scan
stages.prompt: The auto-load surfaces found in this checkout, their execute/inject classification, and the quarantine receipts are attached. Authorise agent entry, request an audit of the quarantined surfaces first, or refuse entry.

work_unit.title: Emit the safe_to_enter verdict with an enumerated surface list
work_unit.question_or_target: Emit safe_to_enter with the enumerated surface list, the quarantine receipts and the owner decision where one was required; safe_to_enter is FALSE unless every prior gate passed, and the surface list is always enumerated - possibly empty - so silence is never the verdict.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: the verdict is what unblocks every downstream agent

work_unit.evidence_requirement: the verdict cites each gate result by name; a TRUE verdict with any gate absent is rejected
tests_required: an absent gate result must produce safe_to_enter false (adverse inference control)
a clean checkout must produce safe_to_enter true WITH an explicit empty surface list
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: an independent reviewer confirms no downstream agent ran with checkout_path as cwd before this artifact existed
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:SEC-6304 when the verdict, the enumerated surface list and every cited gate result are present; otherwise FAILED:SEC-6304 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: no retry - an unresolvable verdict is FALSE

impact.blast_radius: renames aside inside the target checkout and writes under command-center/security/**; a rename is undone by renaming back

mechanism_fingerprint.not_a_duplicate_because: BP-SEC-05 measures LEGAL obligation and pinning on a third-party artifact and blocks on an absent licence; this contains the EXECUTION risk of merely making the directory an agent's cwd, and is the only workflow here that runs entirely before the risky action.

x_extensions.disclosed_gap: surface_patterns is a floor derived from the loader paths known on 2026-08-10. A novel auto-load path would be missed. The settling experiment is a diff of the runtime's own loader source against this pattern list at each runtime upgrade.

worked_example.name: an unregistered marketplace clone that ships its own hooks/
worked_example.narrative: The scan finds four surfaces: hooks/ with two registered commands (would_execute true), .mcp.json naming an npx command line (would_execute true), CLAUDE.md (would_execute false, marked untrusted-data), and AGENTS.md (same). Both executing surfaces are renamed aside with pre/post sha256 equal and a negative existence probe on the original paths, so the clone can still be audited later. trust_level is unknown-third-party, so the owner decision fires and returns audit-quarantined-first; the verdict artifact records safe_to_enter true for the now-inert checkout with the two quarantined surfaces enumerated by path.
